definitions.name: S0A.PRESENT
definitions.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector -> its elements that are not NIL, in order

definitions.name: S0A.SUM
definitions.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> their sum (0 for empty)

definitions.name: S0A.MEAN
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V S0A.SUM V LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> their arithmetic mean

definitions.name: S0A.MAXOF
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Non-empty Vector of numbers -> its largest element

definitions.name: S0A.FFILL
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V S0A.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A E E NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> each NIL replaced by the last present value before it (leading NILs take the first present value)

definitions.name: S0A.NILMASK
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector -> Vector of booleans, TRUE where the element is NIL

definitions.name: S0A.COUNT-TRUE
definitions.body: [ ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: Vector of booleans -> how many are TRUE

definitions.name: S0A.NIL-RUNS
definitions.body: S0A.NILMASK 'M' BIND M [ FALSE ] M -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND S0A.COUNT-TRUE
definitions.note: Vector -> number of runs of consecutive NIL elements

definitions.name: S0A.NIL-RUN-LENGTHS
definitions.body: 0 [ 'E' BIND 1 ADD 0 E NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector -> for each position, length of the NIL run ending there (0 where present)

definitions.name: S0A.LONGEST-NIL-RUN
definitions.body: S0A.NIL-RUN-LENGTHS 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector -> length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 if none)

definitions.name: S0A.PAIR-RATIOS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP DIV
definitions.note: Vector -> each element divided by the one before it (NIL where either is NIL), one shorter

definitions.name: S0A.SCALE-TO-MAX
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V S0A.PRESENT S0A.MAXOF DIV
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> each present value divided by the largest present value, NILs kept

definitions.name: S0A.ARGMAX-KEY
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record of numbers -> the key with the largest value, first key wins ties

definitions.name: S0A.ORDERS
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
definitions.note: JSON text -> the Vector of Records under its "orders" key

definitions.name: S0A.FIELD
definitions.body: 'K' BIND [ K GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of Records, key -> Vector of each Record's value at key (NIL when missing)

definitions.name: S0A.SUM-BY
definitions.body: GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ S0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: keys Vector, numbers Vector -> Record from each distinct key to the sum of its numbers, first-appearance order

definitions.name: S0A.ORDER-REVENUE
definitions.body: S0A.ORDERS 'O' BIND O 'qty' S0A.FIELD O 'price' S0A.FIELD MUL S0A.PRESENT S0A.SUM
definitions.note: orders JSON text -> total qty*price over orders that have a price

definitions.name: S0A.QTY-BY-SKU
definitions.body: S0A.ORDERS 'O' BIND O 'sku' S0A.FIELD O 'qty' S0A.FIELD S0A.SUM-BY
definitions.note: orders JSON text -> Record sku -> summed qty

definitions.name: S0A.FLAT1
definitions.body: [ ] [ CONCAT ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of Vectors -> one Vector, joined end to end

definitions.name: S0A.WORDS
definitions.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: String -> Vector of its space-separated words (extra spaces ignored)

definitions.name: S0A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> them joined by single spaces

definitions.name: S0A.CAPITALIZE
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Non-empty String -> first char upper case, rest lower case

solutions.orders.unpriced: S0A.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER 'sku' S0A.FIELD UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: S0A.ORDERS 'tags' S0A.FIELD S0A.PRESENT [ UNIQUE ] MAP S0A.FLAT1 TALLY
solutions.messy.title: S0A.WORDS [ S0A.CAPITALIZE ] MAP S0A.UNWORDS
